summary.name: Free Download Manager
summary.one_liner: Free Download Manager (FDM) is a free, open-source download accelerator and manager that handles files, videos, torrents and magnet links.
summary.what_it_does: FDM splits files into segments and downloads them at the same time to increase speed. It includes a built-in BitTorrent client that supports torrents and magnet links, with priority control and bandwidth management. Add-ons allow downloading files and videos from supported websites. It automatically resumes interrupted downloads and can intercept downloads from Chrome, Firefox, Edge and other browsers.
notable: Built-in BitTorrent client with magnet link support
Open source and states no adware, malware or spyware
Browser integration for Chrome, Firefox, Edge
caveats: Page does not state any paid tier; the page describes it as 100% free forever
Video downloads depend on add-ons and supported websites only
